relationships.subject: Resolvin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: RvD1, RvD2 and RvE1 prevented histamine-induced TRPV1 sensitisation in DRG neurons at doses devoid of an analgesic effect

relationships.subject: Resolvin D2
relationships.evidence_quote: Of note, RvD2 also reversed TRPV1 sensitisation by histamine and IBS supernatant

relationships.subject: O-1918
relationships.evidence_quote: This effect was blocked by the G protein receptor 18 (GPR18) antagonist O-1918 (3-30 µM) and by pertussis toxin

relationships.subject: Resolvin D2
relationships.evidence_quote: Finally, treatment with RvD2 normalised pain responses to colorectal distention in both preclinical models of VHS

key_findings: RvD1, RvD2 and RvE1 prevent histamine-induced TRPV1 sensitisation in DRG neurons.
RvD2 reverses TRPV1 sensitisation via GPR18 and normalises visceral hypersensitivity in IBS models.
